355)༄༅/bla ma gsang 'dus dngos gzhi la/dkar gtor/gang dag 'dir gnas=mthar zhi rol la dung dkar/sarba bigh+nan=mthar rol mo byin rlabs la dung chen/bzhag rol la

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bla ma gsang 'dus dngos gzhi la/ dkar gtor/ gang dag 'dir gnas= mthar zhi rol la dung dkar/ sarba bigh+nan= mthar rol mo byin rlabs la dung chen/ bzhag rol la rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bla ma rnams kyi= mthar dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ nga ni ye nas= mthar/ dung chen/ chos sku mi 'gyur= mgor/ dung chen/ spyan 'dren 'gor/ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ spyan 'dren mthar/ dung chen/ rkang gsum/ phyi mchod mgor/ dung chen/ snang ba snod kyi= mthar/ dung chen/ le'u bdun/ mdo bskul/ zhog tshogs grol/ ༈ tsha rting la/ badz+ra a mṛ ta= sogs nas/ shab+da'i= zhi rol la/ dung che/ rkang bzhi/ mchod pa mthar/ dung chen/ rnga/ bstod pa mthar/ dung chen/ dkar/ rnga/ rang gi snying ga'i= rkang bzhi 'bud/ glog ma/ sil nang rkang bzhi 'bud bcad ma/ spyan 'dren mthar/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ mchod pa mthar/ dung chen/ rnga/ bstod pa mthar/ dung chen/ rang nyid dpal chen po= trag rak+ṣa= 'bru brdung rkang bzhi/ zil nang rkang bzhi bcad ma/ dung chen/ spyan 'dren mthar/ dung*/ skong ba nang lnga 'bud glog ma/ 'khrugs skong mgor/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ phud 356) bshal zil rnams la dung chen/ bstod pa mgor dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ bzhes la bsam don lhun grub mdzod: mthar dung chen/ ༈ gung tshogs la/ legs ldan mgor rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ mthar/ dung chen/ gza' mgor/ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ rang snang 'od gsal= gdangs mthar rgya gling btang*/ spyan 'dren mgor/ dung chen/ dkar/ dngos grub stsol: thing nas gdangs ma rdzogs bar rgya gling*/ rgyal dbang pad+ma= gdangs gtong dus mgo mtha' gnyis/ dkar/ rgya/ dung chen/ mdun du gangs ri'i= gdangs/ mtshams thams cad rgya gling*/ spyan 'dren mgor 'ur nang dung chen/ dkar/ ting 'dzin sngags dang= gdangs dus le tshan gnyis mtshams rol gnyis la/ dung chen/ rgya/ rdo rje g.yu sgron shin tu= nas rgya gling ma rdzogs bar 'bud/ dur khrod lha mo'i/ mchod pa bzhes: thad nas rgya gling*/ gdangs ma rdzogs bar dang*/ rgyal po dgu rdung gtong dus ma rdzogs bar 'bud dgos/

phyogs phyogs= gdangs che chung gnyis ka'i mthar/ dung chen/ btsan mkhar dmar po'i= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ skyes bu rol pa= dung*/ rgya/ skyes bu srog gi= tsho gsum la/ dung gling yod/ bse mkhar dmar po= 'i/ spyan snga ru= la/ dung*/ rgya/ 357) spros bral chos kyi= tsho gnyis la rgya gling*/ mthar*/ rgya/ dung*/ ljon shing= dang por/ rgya/ gnyis par/ rgya/ dung*/ gter bdag spyan 'dren mthar/ rgya/ dung chen/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= dung dkar/ yid la 'dod pa= dung*/ rgya/ ༈ bar ja dang po la/ tshogs zhus/ rkang bzhi/ dung*/ rgya/ rnga/ rang nyid lha yi= mthar/ dung chen/ tshogs glu/ lan btab/ dung chen/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ bde bar gshegs so= rgya/ sngon byung dus nas= kha 'bud med/ tshogs 'gugs la/ rkang lnga/ glog dung chen/ che mchog pad+ma= sngags bcas mthar/ rkang gsum/ dung chen/ dur khrod gsang ba= mthar ser sbreng*/ rgya/ dam rdzas gtar chen= mgor dung chen/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ gzhung tshig nang*/ rkang lnga/ glog sa ma bcos spros bral= mgor/ dung chen/ sa dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar= la dung chen/ ༈ bar ja gnyis la phyi chog rgyun khyer ltar/ ༈ dgong tshogs la/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i= lhag zhus/ bshugs pa gnyis/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ mthar/ dung chen/ rkang gsum/ gtor 'gugs/ rkang lnga/ dung chen/ sngags 'bul/ rkang lnga/ dung chen/ rgya/ mthar dung chen/ rkang gsum/ rgya/ 358) dung nṛr bkug nas gtang*/ bkra shis mthar/ dung chen/ rgya gling*/ bzhag rol nang rkang gsum/ brtan ma mthar/ rgya/ mchod pa mthar/ rgya/ bstod pa mthar/ dung chen/ bkra shis mthar/ dung chen/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ dkar/ nyul+le bskrad pa/ 'gugs rol gsum la rkang lnga/ dung chen/ 'cham la 'bud mi dgos/ chos kyi dbyings nas= drag sngags so lnga'i mthar/ rkang bzhi/ 'cham pa dkyil 'khor rgyab tu ldog rgyal tshab dril bsil dus/ rkang glog shar gcig shar phyogs dkar mo= mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) rkang bzhi/ yang dril bsil dus rkang gcig
dung chen/ rgya gling byin 'bebs mthar/ dung chen/ rgya/ bzhag rol nang rkang gsum/ dge'o//
